name: neon_cyberpunk
description: A neon-soaked cyberpunk cast on a rain-slick night expressway. The boss is corporate, the worker rides for the platform, the analyst reads the data off the grid.
style: neon-soaked cyberpunk anime illustration, night city just after rain, vivid magenta and cyan neon glow against deep purple and navy darkness, glossy wet surfaces with long light reflections, dramatic rim lighting, crisp anime rendering with bold contrast and a few glowing accents per figure

background.prompt: An elevated rain-soaked city expressway at night seen straight on. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper third: a towering neon skyline of glowing signs and skyscrapers in magenta, cyan and violet, fading into purple haze, kept entirely behind the horizon line. A concrete overpass support sweeps down at the extreme right edge only. Lower third: dark wet asphalt with long neon reflections, metal guardrails hugging the extreme left and right edges. Wide open empty reflective middle with nothing in it.

boss.role: the corporate side - owns the platform, sets the fares, signs nothing
boss.look: a sharp corporate executive in a fitted dark suit with thin glowing cyan trim along the lapels, slicked-back hair, a faint holographic badge on the chest, polished shoes

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, one hand in a trouser pocket, cold confident expression
poses.point: standing and pointing forward with one arm, jaw set, giving a directive
poses.smug: standing with arms crossed and chin slightly raised, thin superior smile
poses.worried: standing with one hand flat against his temple, eyes narrowed at bad news
poses.think: standing with one hand at his chin, lit from below by neon, calculating

worker.role: rides for the platform - absorbs every change in the rate
worker.look: a young courier in a hooded jacket with a magenta glowing stripe, dark cargo trousers, chunky boots, a small headset around the neck, a delivery pack on the back

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, hands loose at the sides, guarded neutral expression
poses.ride: crouched forward gripping invisible handlebars, riding fast to the right, jacket hood fluttering
poses.tired: standing with slumped shoulders under the hood, dim eyes, exhausted
poses.happy: standing with a fist raised in small triumph, a rare grin
poses.confused: standing with head tilted, one hand scratching above the ear, puzzled by the pay statement

analyst.role: reads the data and explains the mechanism
analyst.look: a data analyst with an angular bob haircut, a translucent amber AR visor across the eyes, a black high-collar jacket with thin cyan circuit lines, white cable loops at the collar

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms folded, calm appraising look
poses.explain: standing and gesturing with one open hand turned upward, mid-explanation
poses.point_up: standing and pointing straight upward with one index finger, making a point
poses.think: standing with one hand at the chin under the visor glow, considering

props.hover_bike: a futuristic motorcycle with glowing cyan wheel rings and a magenta tail light, parked on its stand, seen from the side, no rider
props.neon_signboard: a blank rectangular neon sign panel in a dark frame, uniform soft magenta glow, no writing on it
props.holo_board: a translucent glowing hologram presentation board on a slim stand, blank pale cyan surface
props.holo_chart_up: a holographic bar chart card, four glowing bars rising left to right, a cyan upward arrow above them
props.holo_chart_down: a holographic bar chart card, four glowing bars falling left to right, a magenta downward arrow above them
props.drone: a small quad delivery drone with a tiny cargo box slung underneath, hovering, no characters
props.vending_machine: a slim glowing vending machine seen from the front, dark body with rows of softly lit empty panels
props.noodle_counter: a narrow neon-lit noodle-stand counter seen from the front, steam vent and stacked bowls, no characters
props.digital_clock: a rectangular digital wall clock with softly glowing cyan digits on a dark panel
props.credit_chips: a small stack of glowing hexagonal credit chips in a clear case
props.server_rack: a dark server cabinet seen from the front with rows of tiny blinking lights
props.service_counter: a sleek dark service counter seen from the front with a thin glowing edge strip, empty top
props.briefcase: a slim black briefcase with a glowing cyan clasp line
props.rain_umbrella: an open clear-domed umbrella with a thin magenta rim glow, seen from the side

_panel_color_note: Deep violet, between the sky and the asphalt in value, so a panel reads as an interior wall under neon light rather than a hole in the scene.
